name: common-sense-verify
message: [cron:common-sense-verify] Pick ONE behavioral item from agents/shared/common-sense.md that you haven't verified recently (check workspace/common-sense-tracker.md). To check agent behavior: use `bash` with grep/jq to search session transcripts — do NOT read full session.jsonl files (they are 30-300KB and will waste tokens). Example: `grep -l 'keyword' .state/sessions/history/*/session.jsonl` to find relevant sessions, then `grep 'keyword' <file> | head -20` to extract evidence. Only read small excerpts (<5KB). Did the agent follow the rule? Quote evidence. If NO — add to Growth Cycle queue. If YES — mark verified in workspace/common-sense-tracker.md.
description: Verify one common-sense behavioral item against real behavior (4h, graduated from coach heartbeat)

name: common-sense-infra
message: [cron:common-sense-infra] Review agents/shared/common-sense.md. For infra-owned items: what is the highest priority unbuilt mechanism? Has Coach flagged any behavioral items as needing infra help? If you find something to design, write a brief to agents/bob/workspace/. If an item was recently built, update ownership in the doc.
description: Bob reviews common-sense infra gaps (daily, graduated from bob heartbeat)

name: training-sprint
message: [cron:training-sprint] Run a training sprint. Execute: workflow.run("training-sprint", "Automated sprint — scan ERROR_LOGs for top error patterns, check method-catalog.md for untested methods, plan 3-5 experiments, execute them."). Do NOT skip the workflow — run it immediately.
description: Coach runs a batch of gym experiments every 12h — scan errors, fork agents, test methods, record results

name: research-intake
message: [cron:research-intake] Read Scout and Amy-Kimi's latest research for coaching-relevant ideas. Check: (1) agents/scout/workspace/ for new cross-ref or deep-dive files about agent learning, self-improvement, skill formation, or training. Start with cross-reference-synthesis-master-index.md section VIII 'Training & Learning'. (2) agents/amy-kimi/knowledge/insights.md for recent entries. Extract any ideas that could become new improvement methods. If you find something actionable, add it to knowledge/method-catalog.md as a hypothesis entry. Write a brief summary of what you found to workspace/research-notes.md.
description: Coach reads Scout/Amy-Kimi research for new method ideas every 12h
